title: mini-classroom README 核心功能示意图
scenario: 学会制作一个整理会议纪要的 Skill
note: 根据用户确认的四图方案独立编写提示词。每张图只解释一个核心关系；图中学习安排、复习间隔和掌握状态均为示意，不是产品截图或学习效果证据。未使用第三方插画技能模板。

images.concept: 目标拆解：从制作会议纪要 Skill 到今天的一节微课堂
images.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create one finished explanatory illustration for the Chinese README of mini-classroom, a personal AI learning app. Landscape 16:9, target about 1920x1080. The viewer must understand a concrete learning interaction or relationship without reading the README. Use a precise editorial infographic style: front-facing illustrated paper cards, crisp typography, subtle tactile paper and small soft shadows, clean warm off-white background (#F6F7F3), dark charcoal Chinese text, restrained deep teal (#1B6E66) for learning and progress, warm amber (#C28024) only for uncertainty or something needing practice, pale grey for future content. All Chinese characters must be accurate and easily readable at a displayed width of 800 px. Large modern Chinese sans-serif type, clear hierarchy, ample space between sections, generous edge margins, thin clear directional connectors. This is a conceptual illustration, not a software screenshot: no browser frame, navigation, app chrome, fake buttons, sidebars or UI controls. Each graphic should show only the core requested teaching concept. No decorative books, stairs, puzzle pieces, cubes, plants, mascots, 3D scenery, dashboard decoration, marketing badges, export, cheatsheets, settings, appeals, historical logs, or extra features. Do not add small illegible filler text. Do not include any text beyond the exact requested labels. A diagram containing actual content is more important than decoration.

Asset: README opening overview, picture 1 of 4.
Main message: A learner states a concrete goal; the system decomposes it into small learning points; one point becomes today's short lesson, followed by future learning and review. This does not mean an entire Skill is mastered in ten minutes.
Composition: one dominant left-to-right story with THREE clearly distinct zones. A short title at top left. LEFT (24% width): a large speech bubble showing the learner's real goal, with a small simple document marked Skill beneath it; the bubble text is the main object here. CENTER (30% width): four short, neatly stacked connected learning cards, a concrete decomposition of the goal. Highlight only the second card with a deep-teal outline and pale-teal fill. RIGHT (36% width): a larger white teaching card connected by one strong teal arrow specifically from the highlighted second card. Its header specifies the current short lesson. It contains three legible short rows showing lecture, exercise and feedback. A small continuation arrow exits below the teaching card toward one brief future-learning label. The three zones must feel connected, not like a grid of unrelated feature tiles.
Exact text:
Top title: "从一个目标，开始一节微课堂"
Left small label: "学习目标"
Left bubble, two lines: "我想学会制作" / "会议纪要 Skill"
Tiny document label: "Skill"
Center small label: "拆成可学的小步"
Four learning cards top to bottom: "明确用途", "写触发条件", "写执行步骤", "测试效果"
Right header: "今天 · 约 10 分钟"
Right focus line: "写清 Skill 的触发条件"
Three teaching rows: "看懂一个例子", "自己动手写", "获得针对性反馈"
Continuation label: "下次继续学习与复习"
Small unobtrusive footer at bottom right: "功能示意"
Make the concrete named learning cards, highlighted selection, and three learning actions visually prominent. Keep all text unambiguous and readable.

Asset: explanation of one actual learning exercise, picture 2 of 4. Same series as the overview, same teal/amber/grey palette, bold dark title, bright off-white ground, soft low shadows.
Main message: Learning to make a meeting-minutes Skill includes explanation, writing an answer, and feedback that identifies the actual error. One concrete concept ONLY: writing the trigger condition.
Composition: THREE connected illustrated content panels arranged horizontally with large readable headings. Above them a large title, and a short context label. LEFT panel approximately 28%: an explanatory note teaches what a trigger condition describes, with an understated small document illustration supporting the actual text. CENTER approximately 28%: a handwritten-answer paper card with neat printed Chinese text of the user's first attempt. Highlight only the vague word “总结” using an amber underline, and include a small pencil to indicate actual writing. RIGHT approximately 36%: a feedback card has a short amber feedback sentence at top and a clearly separated larger teal corrected wording underneath. TWO simple arrows between the three panels imply flow. Do not show AI chats, appeals, settings, notes export, grading scores or extra functions. The corrected wording must remain the visual conclusion. Do not add a second learning subject.
Exact text:
Main title: "动手写一次，知道哪里还没写清"
Small context label: "练习：会议纪要 Skill 的触发条件"
Panel headings, left to right: "看懂", "试着写", "看反馈，再改进"
Left explanation, large, on 3 short lines: "触发条件要说清：" / "什么时候" / "使用这个 Skill"
Center answer label: "我的初稿"
Center answer: "需要总结时使用"
Right amber feedback: "“总结”的范围太宽"
Right corrected-answer label: "把使用场景写具体"
Right corrected wording on 2 lines: "需要把会议记录" / "整理成纪要时使用"
Bottom-right small footer: "功能示意"
Ensure the process is visually explained with the actual sentence changing from vague to specific. Do not replace content with generic symbols, icons or unreadable lines.

Asset: adaptive review explanation, picture 3 of 4. Same infographic family, title typography, paper-card styling and palette.
Main message: Review timing depends on the learner's answer and confidence. Two knowledge points get different relative review intervals. This is a qualitative explanation, not an exact dated calendar or a scientific forgetting curve.
Composition: a large horizontal timeline under a short title, with TWO clearly separated parallel lanes below it. Timeline progresses left to right. Three clear vertical reference positions: left is the current answer, middle is relatively early review, right is farther in the future. TOP lane begins with a knowledge card on the left for 明确用途 and a teal confidence badge. A long teal directional connector runs across the lane to a matching review card at far right. LOWER lane begins with a knowledge card at the same left position for 写触发条件 and an amber uncertainty badge. A SHORT amber connector ends at a review card near the middle. The short and long journeys must be immediately comparable, with enough negative space that lines do not cross. Repeat the knowledge name inside each corresponding destination card to show exactly what is being reviewed. A small unnumbered clock or recurring-arrow symbol may support a review card, but relationships and labels dominate.
Exact text:
Main title: "复习时间，跟着作答表现调整"
Small context label: "同样在学制作会议纪要 Skill"
Timeline left marker: "本次作答"
Timeline middle marker: "较早复习"
Timeline right marker: "间隔拉长"
Top source card title: "明确用途"
Top source badge: "答得熟练"
Top destination: "复习：明确用途"
Bottom source card title: "写触发条件"
Bottom source badge: "还不清楚"
Bottom destination: "复习：触发条件"
Small bottom-left note: "时间间隔为示意"
Bottom-right footer: "功能示意"
No specific dates, day counts, numerical probabilities, scores, graphs with invented data, fixed schedules, “master everything in 10 minutes” claims or automatic full-stage-reset loops.

Asset: concrete explanation of the learner's cognitive map, picture 4 of 4.
Main message: The learner can see which parts of making a meeting-minutes Skill are learned, what needs consolidation, and what is available to learn next. Show actual named concepts, not abstract blocks or an elaborate 3D map.
Composition: one large title at the top, a short goal label beneath. In the main central band, FOUR spacious related learning cards joined left to right with thin directional connectors. All cards are front-facing with subtle paper depth. FIRST card pale teal with a small check, representing learned material. SECOND card warm pale amber with a small circular review marker, representing already-studied content needing consolidation. THIRD card white with a strong teal outline and one slim pointer, emphasized as what can be learned next. FOURTH card light grey with a dotted outline, representing future learning. The third card can be slightly larger to make the next action easy to spot. Keep the concrete title and status inside every card very legible. This is a conceptual relationship diagram; no browser/window, zoom controls, sidebar, floating panels or interactive 3D terrain.
Exact text:
Main title: "看清已经会什么，找到下一步"
Small goal label: "学习目标：制作会议纪要 Skill"
First card title: "明确用途"
First status: "已掌握"
Second card title: "写触发条件"
Second status: "待巩固"
Third card title: "写执行步骤"
Third status: "下一步可学"
Fourth card title: "测试效果"
Fourth status: "尚未学习"
Small caption centered beneath the cards: "学过的内容可以复习，未学的内容逐步推进"
Bottom-right footer: "学习状态示意"
Show no cheat sheet, export, records, answer detail, personal-link quotation or other secondary features. Communicate status using both color and readable words, never color alone.
